checkpoints.description: No price stated
checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference in bot output. Even framing like 'around $X' or 'about half the price' counts.

checkpoints.description: No hallucinated programs
checkpoints.look_for: bot claims a bookable program exists that is NOT one of: Adult Fundamentals BJJ, Adult All Levels BJJ, Kids 3-5 BJJ, Kids 6-9 BJJ, Kids 10-14 BJJ. Bot MAY acknowledge that Adult Advanced BJJ, Adult Muay Thai, MMA, TRX Fitness, and Private Lessons exist at the gym, but only as non-bookable (must NOT offer a trial slot for those). Also flag any source-bleed program names from other gyms (e.g. 'Kids 7-13 BJJ', 'Champion MA', 'Hammer Sports', 'Mason Dixon').

checkpoints.description: No false closure
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'you're all set', 'you're booked', or similar confirmation WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first. Confirmation must be gated on actual booking success.

checkpoints.description: No hedge language on known negations
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'I don't currently have', 'let me check', 'I'll look that up' on questions where it should give a firm known answer (e.g. 'do you offer Muay Thai trial?' — bot should firmly say no online trial booking, team will follow up, not hedge).

checkpoints.description: No unreplaced merge tokens
checkpoints.look_for: bot output contains unreplaced merge tokens like {{contact.first_name}}, {{variable}}, {{nodes.X.result}}.

checkpoints.description: Never identify as AI/bot
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'I am an AI', 'as a bot', 'I'm an automated assistant', or similar. Emma is presented as a human front desk employee.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before collecting personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks something like 'who is this for — you, a child, or both?' before collecting names, DOBs, or other personal details.

checkpoints.description: Collects DOB for all enrollees before booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks for date of birth (not just age) before calling the booking tool. Verbal age alone is not sufficient.

checkpoints.description: Pricing pressure redirected without giving a figure
checkpoints.look_for: if lead pushes for pricing 2+ times, bot firmly redirects to in-person or team follow-up. Does not eventually cave and give a number.

checkpoints.description: Unaccompanied minor handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: if lead is under 18 with no parent involved (self-booking minor), bot must NOT attempt booking. Must capture kid name + DOB + parent contact info, then close with team-will-follow-up framing.

checkpoints.description: Routes kids age 3-5 to Kids 3-5 BJJ calendar
checkpoints.look_for: for a kid aged 3, 4, or 5 the booking must go to the 'Kids 3-5 BJJ' calendar. Confirmed via GHL appointment.

checkpoints.description: Routes kids age 6-9 to Kids 6-9 BJJ calendar
checkpoints.look_for: for a kid aged 6, 7, 8, or 9 the booking must go to the 'Kids 6-9 BJJ' calendar. Confirmed via GHL appointment.

checkpoints.description: Routes kids age 10-14 to Kids 10-14 BJJ calendar
checkpoints.look_for: for a kid aged 10, 11, 12, 13, or 14 the booking must go to the 'Kids 10-14 BJJ' calendar. Confirmed via GHL appointment.

checkpoints.description: Ages 15-17 on youth path → no booking, team follow-up
checkpoints.look_for: for a kid aged 15, 16, or 17 the bot must NOT book a slot (no calendar exists). Must tag 'minor - needs guardian' and tell the parent the team will reach out.

checkpoints.description: Adult default routes to Adult Fundamentals BJJ
checkpoints.look_for: for a new adult lead without explicit prior BJJ experience, booking must go to 'Adult Fundamentals BJJ' (not Adult All Levels BJJ).

checkpoints.description: Muay Thai acknowledged but not bookable online
checkpoints.look_for: if lead asks about Muay Thai trial, bot acknowledges Muay Thai is offered at the gym but trial booking is not available online — team will follow up. Bot must NOT route a Muay Thai request into a BJJ calendar.

checkpoints.description: MMA acknowledged but not bookable online
checkpoints.look_for: if lead asks about MMA trial, bot acknowledges MMA is offered but not bookable online — team will follow up. No substitute calendar.

checkpoints.description: TRX Fitness acknowledged but not bookable online
checkpoints.look_for: if lead asks about TRX, bot acknowledges TRX is offered but not bookable online — team will follow up.

checkpoints.description: Adult Advanced BJJ redirected to Fundamentals (members only)
checkpoints.look_for: if lead asks to book Advanced BJJ, bot explains it's for current members and offers Adult Fundamentals BJJ as the trial option.

checkpoints.description: CB tag applied after successful booking
checkpoints.look_for: after the booking tool returns success, the bot uses the Update Tags tool to add the 'CB' tag. Verified via GHL contact tags.
